plan.title: Reverse auction auto title after location

steps.note: Open the single-stage creation flow used for the reverse auction.
Switch the event type from the default RFP to Auction.
Select the buy/reverse auction template before adding the product.
Add the specified product with quantity 10 and leave its location unset.

args.label: Enter the title of this event

steps.note: Verify the automatic title remains empty while no location is selected.
Select Plant Name as the product's delivery location.

args.label: Enter the title of this event
args.value: [Reverse Auction] CYLINDER WITH KEY & KNOB - Plant Name

steps.note: Verify the title is generated with the product and selected location.
